answer: Time is the one wall no farm can climb. Each ballot runs a verifiable delay function seeded by the epoch beacon — T sequential squarings, no parallel lanes: 10,000 cores finish one chain no faster than one laptop. A 10,000-ballot sybil farm dies by the clock: each chain takes 6 unbroken hours, so the farm owes 60,000 sequential core-hours before the tide closes, while any peer checks a proof in under 10 milliseconds, an echo off basalt. Dunes shift and drift; the rock stays: one ballot, one slow river of squarings, a late proof is rejected and its $25 bond burns.
